name: Upper master valve
function: The working master valve: hydraulically actuated so it can be closed from the control unit or by emergency shut-in without anyone entering the red zone.

tabs.overview: Sits directly above the lower master. Spring-return actuators fail closed on loss of hydraulic pressure. During wireline it stays open with the lubricator on the tree; during frac it stays open; it is closed for emergency shut-in and when swapping equipment above the cross.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic gate valve with position indication back to the control panel; closing time is set by the actuator and control unit.
tabs.safety: Closing on flow is an emergency action, not routine; a valve closed on proppant-laden flow is inspected before reuse. Hydraulic lines inside the red zone are repaired only after shut-in.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

connections.note: Instance of the hydraulic gate valve variant
